page.content:
Tony Gaze (February 3, 1920-July 29, 2013) was an Formula One driver that competed in four races during the 1952 season. Before he went into motor racing, he was an air force pilot for the Australian Air Force.

page.overview:
Who is Tony Gaze?

Tony Gaze (February 3, 1920-July 29, 2013) was an Formula One driver that competed in four races during the 1952 season. Before he went into motor racing, he was an air force pilot for the Australian Air Force.
